comments: Input facts: ego is the forward-moving car initiator; agent1 is the pedestrian responder; agentStatic is the car responder. Chosen assumptions: the car is stopped ahead in ego's lane; the pedestrian is already walking around its left side in the adjacent same-direction driving lane. After 1 s of forward preparation ego initiates a left bypass into that occupied lane. Agent1 freezes when ego approaches within 11-12 m; agentStatic remains stopped. Car distance 18-19 m, pedestrian longitudinal offset 0.2 m behind its center and lateral offset 2.05-2.15 m left of ego lane center, ordinary walking speed 0.6-0.8 m/s toward a point 0.8 m farther left. Ego target speed 3-3.5 m/s; permissive target-lane check 2.5-3 m; late braking threshold 5.5-6.5 m. Intended observation window 8 s; impact is not required.
